setup.q: How long does it take to set up?
setup.a: Create your club, add your courts with their prices, and you can take your first booking the same day. There's nothing to install and no training needed. If you get stuck, write to us and we'll help you set it up.

cost.a: Every club gets the first month free, with everything unlocked and no card needed. After that, Starter is €{starter} a month for up to {starterCourts} courts, Club is €{club} a month for up to {clubCourts} courts, and Academy is €{academy} a month with no court limit. Paying yearly costs the same as 10 months. Every plan includes unlimited members, there's no setup fee, no commission on bookings, and you can cancel at any time.

app.q: Do my players need to download an app?
app.a: No. RaqHub runs in the browser on any phone, tablet or computer. Players open your club's booking link, sign up with their email or Google account, and book a court.

phone.q: Can I still take bookings by phone or in person?
phone.a: Yes. You can add a booking yourself for a member or a walk-in, so everything ends up in one timetable no matter how the player reached you.

sports.q: Which sports and courts does it support?
sports.a: Tennis, padel and pickleball. Each court has its own sport, surface, indoor or outdoor setting and hourly price, so a club with mixed courts can run them all from one place.

compete.q: Can we run leagues, tournaments and social evenings?
compete.a: Yes, in every plan. Run Americano and Mexicano evenings with a live table, box leagues with promotion and relegation each round, and knockout tournaments for singles or pairs. Players sign up on your club page, and the rounds and draws are made for you. Players can also open a match and find partners at their level, and every league or Americano result nudges their level up or down.

payOnline.a: Not yet. Online payment is in development. For now, players pay at the club the way they do today, and RaqHub records the price of every booking so you can see what each court brings in.

languages.q: Which languages is it available in?
languages.a: English, Macedonian, Serbian, Albanian, German, French and Italian. Each person chooses their own language, so staff and players can use different ones.

data.q: What happens to our data if we stop using RaqHub?
data.a: Your club's data belongs to you. If you decide to leave, tell us and we'll delete your club, members and bookings.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This policy explains what personal data RaqHub collects, why we collect it and what you can do about it. RaqHub is an online booking system for sports clubs: clubs use it to manage their courts, members and coaches, and players use it to book.

sections.title: Who is responsible
body: For your RaqHub account and your use of the website, RaqHub decides how your data is used and is responsible for it (the “controller”). Our contact details are at the end of this page.

When a club records information about its members, walk-in players or bookings, the club decides what to record and is responsible for that data. RaqHub stores and processes it on the club’s behalf (as a “processor”). For questions about that data, contact the club; we will help the club answer you.

sections.title: What data we collect
body: Account details: your name, email address, password (stored only in encrypted form) and your role (player, coach or club admin). If you sign in with Google, Google shares your name, email address and profile photo with us.
Profile details you choose to add, such as a phone number and a profile photo.
Bookings: the court or coach, date and time, price, status, and whether a booking was cancelled or marked as a no-show.
Club details entered by club admins: club name, address, contact details, logo, opening hours, courts, prices and booking rules.
Coach profiles: a coach’s name and photo, the levels and specialities they teach, their price and a short description. Coach profiles are public.
Member data entered by clubs: name, email address, phone number, membership plan and status, and private notes that only the club can see.
Technical data: the cookies described below, and server logs (such as IP address and browser type) kept by our hosting providers for security and troubleshooting.
We don’t use advertising, tracking or analytics cookies, and we don’t sell your data.

sections.title: Why we use it
body: To provide the service: creating your account, taking bookings, showing clubs their timetable, and sending booking confirmations and reminders. Legal basis: performing our contract with you.
To keep the service safe and working: preventing abuse, fixing errors and applying each club’s booking rules. Legal basis: our legitimate interest in running a secure, reliable service.
For club billing: invoicing clubs for their plan and keeping accounting records. Legal basis: our contract with the club and our legal obligations.
To answer you when you write to us.
We send emails only about your account and your bookings (and, to club admins, about the club’s plan and weekly reports). We won’t send you marketing emails unless you agree to them first.

sections.title: Who can see your data
body: The club you book with sees your name, contact details and your bookings at that club, including no-shows.
Everyone can see club pages, courts, opening hours and coach profiles.

Service providers that run parts of RaqHub for us: Supabase (database, sign-in and file storage), our email provider (Resend or a standard mail service) and our web hosting provider. They may use the data only to provide their service to us.
Authorities, when the law requires us to share it.

Some of these providers are based in, or use servers in, other countries, including the United States. When data leaves North Macedonia or the European Union, we rely on the safeguards the law requires, such as the European Commission’s Standard Contractual Clauses.

sections.title: How long we keep it
body: Account and profile data: for as long as your account exists. When you ask us to delete your account, we delete or anonymise your data within 30 days.
Bookings: for as long as the club’s account exists, because the club needs its booking history. No-shows count toward a club’s booking limits only for 90 days.
Club data: for as long as the club uses RaqHub, and for 90 days after it stops, so it can come back without losing anything. Invoices and accounting records are kept for as long as tax law requires.
Server logs: for a short time, as set by our hosting providers.

sections.title: Cookies
body: RaqHub only uses cookies that the site needs to work:
Sign-in cookies set by Supabase, which keep you signed in.
A language cookie (NEXT_LOCALE), which remembers the language you chose.
Because these cookies are strictly necessary, we don’t ask for consent to use them. If you block them, you won’t be able to sign in.

sections.title: Your rights
body: At any time, you can:
see the personal data we hold about you and get a copy of it;
have data that is wrong or incomplete corrected;
have your data and your account deleted;
restrict or object to how we use your data;
get your data in a common, machine-readable format so you can take it elsewhere;
withdraw any consent you have given.
Write to {email} from the email address on your account. We will reply within one month. If your request is about data a club recorded about you, we will pass it on to the club.

If you think we have handled your data wrongly, you can complain to the Agency for Personal Data Protection of North Macedonia (azlp.mk) or to the data protection authority of the EU country where you live.

sections.title: Security
body: All data travels over encrypted connections (HTTPS). Passwords are stored in encrypted form, and neither we nor the clubs can see them. Database access rules make sure each club can see only its own data and each player only their own bookings.

sections.title: Children
body: RaqHub is not meant for children under 14 to use on their own. A parent or guardian can create an account and make bookings for a child.

sections.title: Changes to this policy
body: We may update this policy when the service changes. The date at the top shows when it last changed. If the changes are important, we will tell users by email or in the app before they apply.

privacy.contact: For questions about this policy or your data, write to {email}.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.intro: These terms apply to everyone who uses RaqHub: clubs that manage their courts with it and players who book through it. By creating an account or using the site, you accept these terms.

sections.title: The service
body: RaqHub is online software for sports clubs. Clubs publish their courts, opening hours, prices, coaches and memberships, and players book courts and lessons online. RaqHub only provides the software: we don’t run clubs, own courts or employ coaches.

sections.title: Your account
body: Give accurate information when you sign up and keep it up to date.
Keep your password to yourself and don’t share your account. You are responsible for what is done with it.
If you think someone else has used your account, tell us straight away at {email}.

sections.title: Bookings
body: A booking is an agreement between you and the club. The club sets the prices, opening hours and booking rules, and is responsible for the court, the lesson and any payment it collects.
You pay for bookings to the club, in the way the club arranges. RaqHub doesn’t take payments for bookings.

Each club can set rules, such as how long a booking can be, how far ahead you can book, how many bookings you can make per day and how late you can still cancel online. After that time, contact the club to cancel.

If you don’t turn up for a booking, the club can mark it as a no-show. A club can pause online booking for players with too many no-shows in the last 90 days. The club can still book for you directly.
Questions about a booking, a refund or a cancelled session are between you and the club, but we are happy to help where we can.

sections.title: Plans for clubs
body: New clubs get a free {trialDays}-day trial with every feature included. No card is needed.
After the trial, a club continues on a paid plan (Starter, Club or Academy), billed monthly or yearly. Current prices are on the pricing page.
We invoice clubs in advance for each period. Plans don’t renew automatically: a club keeps its plan by paying the next invoice.
If an invoice isn’t paid, we may limit the club’s features or suspend its account after letting the club know. The club’s data stays available for 90 days.
A club can stop at any time by not renewing. Fees already paid are not refunded, except where the law requires it.
We may change prices with at least 30 days’ notice. New prices apply from the next billing period.

sections.title: What clubs are responsible for
body: Clubs are responsible for the information they publish and for the data they enter about their members and players. They must have a lawful reason to record it and must let their members know that they use RaqHub.
For that data, the club is the controller and RaqHub is its processor, as described in the Privacy Policy. We process it only to provide the service to the club.
Clubs must honour bookings made through RaqHub under the rules they set, or contact the player if a booking can’t go ahead.

sections.title: Acceptable use
body: Don’t use RaqHub to:
do anything illegal;
make fake bookings or hold courts you don’t intend to use;
upload content you don’t have the right to use, or content that is offensive;
try to access other people’s data or get around the site’s security;
overload the service with automated requests.

sections.title: Your content
body: You keep the rights to what you upload, such as logos, photos and descriptions. You allow us to store and show it as needed to run the service, for example a club’s logo on its public page. The RaqHub name, software and design belong to us.

sections.title: Availability and liability
body: We work to keep RaqHub available and accurate, but we can’t promise it will always run without interruptions or errors. We may pause it briefly for maintenance.
RaqHub is not responsible for what happens at a club, for a club’s decisions, or for losses caused by a booking problem we couldn’t reasonably have prevented.
As far as the law allows, our total liability to a club is limited to the fees the club paid us in the 12 months before the claim.
Nothing in these terms limits liability that the law doesn’t allow to be limited, or your rights as a consumer.

sections.title: Ending your use
body: You can stop using RaqHub and ask us to delete your account at any time.
We may suspend or close an account that breaks these terms, after a warning where that is reasonable.

sections.title: Changes to these terms
body: We may change these terms. The date at the top shows when they last changed, and we will tell users about important changes before they apply. If you keep using RaqHub after that, the new terms apply.

sections.title: Applicable law
body: These terms are governed by the law of North Macedonia. Disputes go to the competent court in Skopje, unless consumer law gives you the right to go to a court where you live.

tt_read.q: What do the colours on the timetable mean?
tt_read.a: Each court is a column and each row is an hour. Green blocks are upcoming bookings and grey ones have already been played. Lessons show the coach's name, and group sessions the group's name. Tap a block to see who booked it.

tt_add.q: How do I add a booking for someone who called?
tt_add.a: Go to Bookings and tap Add booking. Pick the court, then a member from your list or Walk-in with just a name, and the time. It shows on the timetable straight away.

tt_days.q: How do I see another day?
tt_days.a: Use the arrows above the timetable to go a day back or forward, and Today to come back.

bk_weekly.q: How do I book the same court every week?
bk_weekly.a: When adding a booking, set Repeat to every week for a number of weeks. Weeks when the court is already taken are skipped, and you see which ones.

bk_cancel.q: How do I cancel or change a booking?
bk_cancel.a: In Bookings, change the status in the booking's row to Cancelled. For a weekly booking you can cancel only that week, or that week and every later one. The player gets a notification.

bk_noshow.q: What happens when I mark a no-show?
bk_noshow.a: It counts towards the no-show limit in Settings > Booking Rules. After too many, the player can't book online until you change one back or 90 days pass. You can always still book for them.

bk_export.a: Yes. Settings > Your data has a Download button for every booking and lesson as a spreadsheet you can open in Excel.

db_numbers.q: Where do the dashboard numbers come from?
db_numbers.a: From your bookings and members: today's bookings, this week's revenue compared with last week, and your active members and courts. They update as soon as something is booked.

db_share.q: How do players find my club?
db_share.a: Send them your booking link, or print the QR poster from Share. Players open it on their phone, sign up with email or Google, and book. There's no app to install.

mb_add.q: How do I add my existing members?
mb_add.a: Tap Add member and fill in the name, plan and end date. Add their email too: when they sign up to RaqHub with that email, their membership and discount are linked automatically.

mb_discount.q: Why doesn't a member get their discount?
mb_discount.a: The discount applies when the email on the member matches the email the player signs in with, and the membership is active. Check both in the member's details.

mb_bulk.q: Can I extend or email many members at once?
mb_bulk.a: Yes. Tick the members in the list, then extend their memberships, change their plan, cancel them, or email them all together.

mb_ending.q: How do I see memberships about to end?
mb_ending.a: Open the Ending soon tab. Members also get a reminder a week before, and you get one summary a day in your notifications.

pl_create.a: A plan has a price, how often it's paid, and a discount on every booking. Give a member a plan and their bookings get the discount automatically. Payment for the plan happens at the club.

co_add.q: How do I add a coach?
co_add.a: The coach first signs up to RaqHub as a player. Then tap Add coach, enter their email, price per hour and levels. Players can then book lessons with them.

co_lessons.q: Does a lesson hold a court?
co_lessons.a: Yes. When a player books a lesson, RaqHub gives it a free court of the coach's sport, so nobody else can book over it.

gr_create.q: How do I set up a coaching group?
gr_create.a: Tap New group and pick the coach, court, days, times and season. RaqHub holds the court for every session and puts them on the timetable. Skip holidays with breaks.

gr_register.q: How does the coach take the register?
gr_register.a: The coach opens My groups on their phone and taps Register for today's session, then ticks who came. Parents can also say in advance that their child can't come.

gr_fees.q: How do I keep track of monthly fees?
gr_fees.a: Open the group's Fees tab and mark each player as paid, in cash or by bank. Remind unpaid sends a friendly email to every parent who hasn't paid yet.

gr_waiting.q: What happens when a group is full?
gr_waiting.a: New sign-ups go on the waiting list. When a place opens, the next person gets an email and 48 hours to take it, then it goes to the one after.

om_what.a: A player books a court and opens it to others at their level, for example two more for padel. Players join online and each pays their share at the club. The court is an ordinary booking on your timetable.

om_release.q: What if an open match doesn't fill up?
om_release.a: A few hours before the start, which you choose in the settings here, the organiser is asked whether to keep the court. If they don't, it's given back and goes on sale again.

om_levels.a: Players rate themselves from 1.0 to 7.0. If one asks you to check, they show up here: confirm their level, or change it first. Other players then see it was checked by your club.

ct_add.q: How do I add several courts at once?
ct_add.a: In Add court, set How many. RaqHub adds them with numbered names, like Clay court 1 to 4, each with the same sport, surface and price.

ct_off.q: How do I close a court for a while?
ct_off.a: Set it to Inactive. Players can't book it, and you can switch it back on any time. Your plan's court limit only counts active courts.

ct_price.a: Yes, each court has its own price per hour. Members with a plan get their discount on top.

tn_create.q: How do I run a tournament?
tn_create.a: Create it with a date and number of places, then share the link. Players sign up online, or you add names yourself, like Ana / Marko for doubles.

tn_draw.a: Close sign-ups and tap Make the draw. Players are placed at random, and if the number doesn't fit the bracket, some go straight to round 2. Tap a match to enter the winner and score.

an_read.q: What can I learn from analytics?
an_read.a: Which courts and hours are busiest, revenue by sport and over time, and how your membership grows. The peak hours chart shows when off-peak prices or groups could fill empty courts.

st_hours.q: How do I set opening hours?
st_hours.a: In Settings > Opening Hours, set the times for each day or mark a day closed. Players can only book inside these hours.

st_rules.q: What can I control in Booking Rules?
st_rules.a: Which booking lengths players can choose, how many days ahead they can book, how many bookings a day each player can make, until when they can cancel online, and when repeat no-shows pause online booking.

st_delete.q: How do I delete my club?
st_delete.a: In Settings > Your data, download anything you want to keep, then use Email us. We delete your club, courts, members and bookings for good.

sf_invite.q: How do I give my receptionist a login?
sf_invite.a: Go to Staff and enter their email. They get an invite, sign in with that email, and see your club straight away. You can remove them at any time.

sf_can.a: See the timetable, add, change and cancel bookings, and manage members and groups. Only you can change settings, courts, coaches, plans and your RaqHub plan.

sh_link.q: What's the best way to get players booking?
sh_link.a: Send the ready-made message to your club's Viber or WhatsApp group, and hang the QR poster at reception and by the courts. Most clubs get their first online booking within a day.

ga_plan.q: How do I pay for RaqHub?
ga_plan.a: Your first month is free. To continue, write to us and we'll send you an invoice for your plan. You can see your plan and paid-until date in Settings.

ga_language.q: Can my staff use another language?
ga_language.a: Yes. Everyone picks their own language with the language button at the top. Emails to players go out in the language they booked in.

ga_notifications.q: How do I choose which notifications I get?
ga_notifications.a: Open the bell, then Notifications, and switch off the kinds you don't need. It only changes yours, not your staff's.

pb_book.q: How do I book a court?
pb_book.a: Pick a court, then the day, start time and length, and confirm. You get an email straight away, and the booking shows under My bookings.

pb_pay.a: You pay at the club, the way you always have. The price shown already includes your member discount, if you have one.

pb_closed.q: Why can't I pick some times or days?
pb_closed.a: Either the court is already booked, the club is closed then, or it's further ahead than the club allows. Each club sets its own booking rules.

pm_cancel.q: How do I cancel a booking?
pm_cancel.a: Open My bookings and tap Cancel booking. Some clubs only allow cancelling up to a few hours before. After that, call the club.

pm_calendar.q: Can I add a booking to my calendar?
pm_calendar.a: Yes, tap Add to calendar on the booking. It opens in Google Calendar, ready to save.

pm_noshow.q: Why can't I book online any more?
pm_noshow.a: If you missed several bookings without cancelling, the club may pause online booking for you. Call the club: they can still book for you, and lift the pause.

pc_lesson.q: How do I book a lesson?
pc_lesson.a: Open Find a coach, pick a coach and a free time. The club holds a court for the lesson, and you pay the coach or the club as usual.

pg_where.q: Why don't I see my child's group?
pg_where.a: Groups show here when the club added your child with the same email you sign in with. If yours is missing, ask the club to check the email they have.

pg_absent.q: How do I say my child can't come?
pg_absent.a: Tap Can't come on the session. The coach sees it on the register, and you can undo it if plans change.

pg_fees.q: How do I pay the group fee?
pg_fees.a: Pay the club or the coach in cash or by bank transfer. Once they mark it, it shows as paid here.

pom_join.q: How do I join an open match?
pom_join.a: Set your level once, then tap Join on a match at your level. If your level is outside the range, Ask to join, and the organiser decides. You pay your share at the club.

pom_start.q: How do I start a match?
pom_start.a: Tap Start a match, pick the court and time, and choose who can join. The court is booked for you right away. Share the link in your group chats to fill it faster.

pom_level.a: Levels go from 1.0 to 7.0, and you set your own for each sport. A coach at your club can confirm it, and other players then see it was checked.

pom_release.q: What if my match doesn't fill up?
pom_release.a: A few hours before the start we ask whether to keep the court. If you don't answer, it goes back to the club and the match is off, so nobody pays for an empty court.

pom_leave.q: Can I leave a match I joined?
pom_leave.a: Yes, until the club's cancel deadline. After that, tell the organiser, because leaving late can count as a no-show.

pp_membership.q: How do I become a member?
pp_membership.a: Memberships are handled by the club. Ask them to add you with the same email you sign in with, and your discount applies to every booking.

pp_name.q: How do I change my name or phone?
pp_name.a: Open Profile, change your details and tap Save changes. The club sees your new details on your bookings.

pgen_notifications.a: Reminders the day before you play, changes the club makes to your bookings, and news about your groups and matches. Switch off what you don't need under Notifications.

pgen_language.q: How do I change the language?
pgen_language.a: Use the language button at the top of the page. Your emails switch to that language for your next bookings.

ct_close.q: How do I close a court for repairs, rain or a holiday?
ct_close.a: Tap Close courts on the Courts page or in the timetable. Pick the courts, the days or hours, and a reason. Bookings already made for that time are cancelled, and the players get a notification and an email saying why. Nobody can book until the closure ends or you tap Reopen.
